_comment: Data, not law. Official Central Bureau of Statistics series as published by the CBS API; not a consolidation. Deposited 2026-10-08 for BACKLOG IL-35. One canonical copy, here; the income-tax rows should cite this path.

files.title: Israel CBS consumer price index, general (code 120010)
files.description: Monthly general CPI (Madad HaMechirim LaTzarchan - Klali, code 120010), every month January 2000 to August 2026 (320 rows), each reading in the base in force when it was published (base 2024 average from January 2025, 2022 for 2023-24, down to 1998 for 2000), with percent and percentYear.
files.retrieved_via: CBS public index API (api.cbs.gov.il), GET through the il-central-1 proxy; the CBS host reset some connections and the request was retried until it answered
files.latest_reading: August 2026 (published in September 2026); the September 2026 reading is not yet published at retrieval
files.feeds: NII s 334(a)(1) and ITO s 120B (the CPI-linked updating); the encoder reads the law for which month pair and which base it needs
